newsitem.title: BULGARIA: ALBANIA EVACUEES ARRIVE IN BULGARIA.
newsitem.headline: ALBANIA EVACUEES ARRIVE IN BULGARIA.

text.p: The first plane to leave Tirana airport since it was closed a week ago by armed unrest landed in Sofia on Thursday with 30 passengers of various nationalities on board.
They included 14 Albanians admitted by the Bulgarian authorities on humanitarian grounds although one 16-year-old boy had no documents and those of two girls had expired.
The evacuees said the Bulgarian authorities had been very helpful to them both in Tirana and in Sofia.
The Albanian Airlines plane took off only hours after airport authorities declared the airport had been secured by special forces, all key staff were in place and it was open for business.

Tirana airport is Albania's main gateway to the outside world, and the staging point for any flow of the humanitarian aid that its government and European observers say it will require soon to cope with food and other shortages.
